description: A quietly influential Labour policymaker who under Neil Kinnock helped the party rethink its stance on Europe The socialist economist Stuart Holland, who has died aged 86, spent only a decade as an MP and never became a public figure outside the cloisters of Westminster or those of the institutions of his later academic life, yet he exerted a largely unacknowledged influence on Labour party economic policymaking for three decades and was widely respected on the political left across Europe. description: The Federal Aviation Administration imposed new standards for its Line Up and Wait airport policy on Tuesday that, though not a significant change, could affect travelers during the busy holiday travel season. Line Up and Wait (LUAW) is a procedure that allows planes preparing for departure from busy airports to taxi into position on the runway while they wait to be cleared for takeoff. It’s designed to make airport departures more efficient by putting planes in position to take off as soon as airspace has been cleared. Under the FAA’s new policy , airports can still use LUAW, but they must designate a watch supervisor whose sole job is to oversee LUAW operations and whose attention cannot be split by other tasks. The new rules change guidance from saying that airports “should” have a dedicated LUAW supervisor to saying that they “must” have one. The FAA said the change is intended to “elevate the safety standard” for LUAW operations by “removing ambiguity” about staffing requirements...
